exposure: Cardiac, liver, and kidney injury markers
cohort: The study included 576 children with lower respiratory tract infections (LRTIs), divided into a group with asthma-like symptoms (ALS) and a group without ALS.
finding: Lower age, male sex, inflammation, and an allergic state were identified as risk factors for asthma-like symptoms onset in children with lower respiratory tract infections.
cross-section timing: At the time of diagnosis of lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI) and enrollment into the study.
